thread:
Maria (SDK PM): Quick heads-up — rolling out a small but important SDK + docs change tomorrow at 09:00 PT. This affects the CLI flag behavior and ships a new 'Structured Output' landing page. :megaphone:
Alex (Docs): Nice — what's the impact surface? Breaking? migration path?
Maria (SDK PM): Not a hard break but a behavioural change. We're deprecating the legacy `--compact-json` flag and introducing `--structured-output` which normalizes field names and enforces stable schema by default. Migration adapter will be available in SDK v3.4.
Emily (DevEx): TL;DR for users: replace `--compact-json` with `--structured-output preserve-compat` to keep old behavior for 60 days. We'll provide snippets. :white_check_mark:
Alex (Docs): I'll publish the landing page + migration guide before deploy. Draft checklist: short explainer, examples for CLI/SDK, one deprecation banner at top, and a compatibility snippet.
Jamal (Runtime): Any runtime-level fallbacks we need? Does `preserve-compat` cause different tokenization?
Maria (SDK PM): No tokenization changes. `preserve-compat` toggles output post-processing only. Runtime unaffected but we need to ensure telemetry flags don't leak PII during normalization.
Emily (DevEx): I'll add migration snippets to the quickstart and the interactive playground. Example snippet for CLI users:
```bash
# old
redwood-cli generate --compact-json input.txt > out.json
# new
redwood-cli generate --structured-output normalize input.txt > out.json
# compatibility shim for 60 days
redwood-cli generate --structured-output preserve-compat input.txt > out.json
```
Alex (Docs): Publishing plan: 09:00 PT docs update + banner; 09:05 PT SDK release note; 09:10 PT blog micro-post (internal). Can someone run the smoke tests after docs deploy?
Jamal (Runtime): I'll kick off the runtime smoke job at 09:12 and watch latencies. If anything >10% delta I'll rollback.
release-bot: deploy scheduled: docs@09:00 PT, sdk-v3.4@09:05 PT (initiated by @Maria). See: https://deploys.redwood.example/1719087654
docs-bot: Published: /docs/structured-output (draft -> live). Migration guide at /docs/migration/compact-json-to-structured-output.
Maria (SDK PM): Rollout policy: feature-gate on by default for new installs; existing CLI users get deprecation warnings when they use `--compact-json`. We'll keep the shim for 60 days then remove. Internal ticket: RD-4572 (migration telemetry + linter update).
Emily (DevEx): Can we add an automated codemod for the repo samples? I can run a script to update example repos we control.
Alex (Docs): Please add a short note in the changelog about telemetry — we must be explicit about which fields we normalize and which we leave untouched.
Jamal (Runtime): Noted. Also planning a quick rollback plan: 1) disable feature-gate 2) revert docs banner 3) emergency patch to re-enable `--compact-json` parsing. Keep the timeline pinned.
Maria (SDK PM): Thanks all. Action items: Alex publish landing + banner; Emily update quickstart + playground; Jamal run runtime smoke; I'll monitor telemetry and reactions. Ping me if you see anything odd. :rocket:
Alex (Docs): Will do. Posting follow-up with PR links and checklist in ~15m.
Maria (SDK PM): FYI — communication to support stack scheduled after 09:30 PT with suggested troubleshooting steps.
Emily (DevEx): I'll drop the codemod link in this thread when ready.
Maria (SDK PM): End of thread — will post update if we change the window.
